name: Active-client rejection sends a 'Could Not Be Accepted' email to the broker
description:
Objective: Active-client rejection sends a 'Could Not Be Accepted' email to the broker.
Preconditions: Open Application emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Application emails.
2. Active-client rejection sends a 'Could Not Be Accepted' email to the broker.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: When an application is rejected because the client has an active deal, APPLICATION_REJECTED_ACTIVE_CLIENT email must be delivered in the configured app env.
